provenance.file: publisher PDF via NSF PAR record 10451706 (par.nsf.gov/servlets/purl/10451706); local copy 10451706.pdf, not committed
provenance.notes: Fig. 2a compares NO3- decay for three cathode configurations at -2 V vs SCE, 25 mM NO3-, pH ~7, 10 mM Cl-. Only nitrate was plotted, so this is a single-species dataset (no NO2-, TAN or trap data for this configuration). METHOD: raster digitization of the embedded figure image (main PDF page 6): y axis calibrated from 6 located tick marks (0-25 mM, max residual 0.01 mM), x from 7 located major ticks; markers segmented by colour (OpenCV) and reduced to connected-component centres; times snapped to the nominal 20-min grid (marker x positions sit +0.3 min right of the tick centroids, a uniform offset). 0.078 mM per pixel. The t = 0 markers of all three series overlap (only the orange one is fully visible); t = 0 is pinned to 25 mM. Shaded error bands in the figure were not extracted. Extracted by agent team 2026-10-20; overlay on the figure crop checked by eye (scratch). Triangle centres are area centroids; the bounding-box centre would read about 0.25 mM higher. We chose the centroid because the partly hidden t = 0 triangle then sits at 24.9 mM, level with the t = 0 circle, while the box centre puts it at 25.25 mM. Verifier check (2026-10-20), a stronger reason for the centroid choice: in the Fig. 2a legend the text-line centres are evenly spaced (22.30 px), the legend ring and filled circle sit 0.45-0.64 px above their text lines, and the legend triangle's area centroid sits 0.45 px above its line while its bounding-box centre sits 3.25 px above; so the plotting software anchors triangles at their area centroid. Text: pseudo-first-order kap 0.010 min-1 for this cathode. quality.n_closure in the converted dataset is the nitrate fraction NO3/c0 only, not a nitrogen closure: no other species were plotted for this configuration. Licence/terms: publisher copyright (ACS); NSF public-access copy. The PAR record (par.nsf.gov/biblio/10451706) states no reuse licence; the downloaded file is the ACS typeset article (PAR labels its full text 'Accepted Manuscript') and carries the ACS notice 'See https://pubs.acs.org/sharingguidelines for options on how to legitimately share published articles'. Checked Oct 20 2026.

conditions.catalyst: pristine Cu foam (HCl-cleaned, no CuO layer) clipped to the PTFE/PP membrane, 4 cm2
conditions.electrolyte: synthetic wastewater: 25 mM NO3- (as N; KNO3) + 10 mM Cl- + 0.5 M Na2SO4, initial pH 7.0
conditions.potential_as_reported: -2.0 V vs SCE (no ohmic compensation; SCE +0.241 V vs SHE)
conditions.stirring: recirculation by peristaltic pumps at 50 mL/min (cathode loop: feed tank <-> cathode chamber; trap loop: trap tank -> trap chamber -> anode chamber -> trap tank)
conditions.notes: Same three-chamber flow cell as the CuO/PTFE runs, but the cathode membrane is pristine Cu foam on the PTFE/PP membrane (no CuO layer; SI Fig. S2c): trap | Cu-foam/PTFE cathode membrane | cathode chamber | Nafion 117 PEM | anode chamber (Pt mesh 3.5x3.5 cm); SCE reference in the cathode chamber; CHI 1100C potentiostat. This configuration keeps gas extraction through the PTFE membrane into the trap chamber, as in the main runs (Fig. S2c compares the cathodes with/without gas extraction). volume_mL is the feed tank: 50 mL is stated in the text only for the Fig. 2e run and is assumed here; chamber and trap-tank volumes not stated. pH is the initial feed pH (Fig. 2a caption: pH ~7.0). Not reported for this configuration: current or current density, in-run cathode-loop and trap pH, and any NO2-, TAN or trap data (only NO3- is plotted in Fig. 2a). The text's ~50 mA cm-2 (0.204 +/- 0.011 A) and pH values 12.65 (cathode loop) and 1.53 (trap tank after 120 min) belong to the CuO-coated Cu foam/PTFE run of Fig. 2e, not to this one. RHE conversion not done: large uncompensated iR, and the in-run pH is not reported. Text: kap 0.010 min-1 for this cathode.

quality.n_basis_note: Axis label 'N-NO3- concentration (mM)': nitrate expressed as N; no conversion.
